claim: A Python script sent through the Bash tool as a quoted heredoc does not receive a doubled backslash as written: '\\n' arrives as a real newline, so the script fails with an unterminated string or silently fails to match.
evidence: Seen three times on 2026-11-19. The cause is believed to be the tool reducing escapes before Python sees them; not confirmed against the tool's source.
use: Write the script to a file with the Write tool and run it, or build such strings with chr(10) / chr(92).
